name: Saap Saap Thai and Kaffe & Toast - Tampines Mall
description:
MUST TRY: Signature Beef Boat Noodle, Kaya Butter Toast, Butter Sugar Toast, Chicken Ham and Cheese Muffin, Strawberry Jam Bun, Mee Siam, Laksa. Kaffe & Toast is a Halal-certified cafe that offers a delightful experience with their menu featuring delicious Thai and Local cuisines. They serve a variety of traditional toast sets, Asian and local delights, Thai boat noodles, soft buns and muffins, as well as coffee, tea and other beverages. Located at Tampines Mall (nearest train: Tampines MRT Station), Kaffee & Toast provides a comfortable setting and a pleasant environment which makes it a great place to chill out together with your family and friends 
Source: hungrygowhere.com
